content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Rockford

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's dual-track requirements: one path for bachelor's-degree holders, another for those without. Verify your hours now to avoid delays when you're ready to submit your application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions on your schedule—no fixed classroom location required. Active certified practitioners deliver real-world context across every module, giving you the foundation and contact hours PMI mandates for exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal application to PMI with proof of education, project experience, and training hours. Pay the associated exam fee to secure your testing eligibility. PMI will review and approve your profile before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and strategy sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam when ready. The PMP® tests your knowledge across project-management domains; thorough preparation is the clearest path to passing on your first attempt.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, commit to the three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or conference attendance. Renew on schedule to keep your credential active and competitive in Rockford's advanced-manufacturing, healthcare, and logistics sectors.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
